settings.librarySync.rebuildSub: Discard this Mac's synced library data and rebuild it from iCloud
settings.librarySync.rebuildConfirmMsg: Quill will publish this Mac's unsynced changes, then discard its local library data — books, highlights, vocabulary, collections, and chats — and rebuild everything from the logs and snapshots in iCloud. Nothing in iCloud is deleted or modified, and your book files, settings, and API keys stay untouched. Local changes that were never queued for sync cannot be recovered.
settings.librarySync.removeDeviceBody: This device's log, snapshot, and manifest in iCloud will be deleted. Any books already synced to this device are kept. The other device will reappear here if it opens Quill again and re-registers.
